Hello W-Fitness team,

I'm Janani, and I build websites for gyms and fitness studios in Chennai. I was looking at wfitness.co.in this week. Your members' reviews on your site are lovely, and they all say the same thing: a safe, friendly women's-only gym where the trainers really care.

So I rebuilt it, using your own photos and details. Here's how it looks today and how it could look, on a computer and on a phone:
A:
See it live: https://jananiporkodi.github.io/revamp/w-fitness/
Open it on your phone and scroll slowly. You see a bright grid of your gym, then your cardio row, group floor classes and strength machines rise up one by one with a short line each.

Why this matters now: AI search. More and more people skip Google and simply ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google's AI answers for “a gym in Madipakkam”. These assistants recommend the businesses whose websites clearly tell them who you are, where you are and what you offer. Right now wfitness.co.in doesn't give these tools your business details in a form they can read, like most websites built a few years ago. Your new website is built for it: your details are written in the standard format AI tools read (schema.org), it has a clear question-and-answer section, and an llms.txt file made for AI assistants.

What you get for ₹25,000 (one-time)

  • This new website, live on your own domain (wfitness.co.in)
  • Works smoothly on phones and computers
  • Ready for AI search: your timings, facilities, programmes, address and answers to common questions, written so ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI answers can read and recommend you
  • A “book a visit” button that sends the date straight to your WhatsApp
  • Call and WhatsApp buttons on every screen
  • Basic Google setup, so members searching for gyms in Madipakkam can find you
  • Two rounds of changes: new photos, prices, wording, anything you like
  • One month of free fixes after launch
  • Free hosting: no monthly server bill
  • Payment: half to start, half when the site goes live

Timeline: live in 7 days

  • Day 1: a quick call, and we start
  • Days 2–3: you send any new photos or changes
  • Day 5: you see the updated version
  • Day 7: it goes live on wfitness.co.in

If you like it, just reply to this email or WhatsApp me on +91 98844 26074, and I'll call you at a time that suits you. If it's not for you, no problem. I'll take the preview down.

Warm regards,
Janani Porkodi
+91 98844 26074
